about: One sample per run-pipeline tool branch, each also carrying ride-along paths, so a few detonations exercise every tool. Branches are exclusive (chosen by the input's type), so the floor is one sample per branch. A sample is kept only if a real run passes every predicate in `expect` (report-shape.py). Build it out over time; see ADR-031.

samples.note: Native PE (no branch); runs encoded PowerShell. Report 21ab9faaeeaf. Retire once native-dotnet-payload and script-powershell both exist: together they cover it.

samples.select: A native (non-.NET) PE loader or dropper whose unpacked payload is .NET (e.g. a crypter-wrapped AgentTesla or a .NET RAT). The payload path runs only for native inputs, so an Office or script dropper does not exercise it.
A macro-enabled Office document (VBA) that still runs its macro without live C2.
A JS or VBS dropper (WSH) that launches encoded PowerShell.
A PyInstaller-packed Windows stealer or RAT (the MEI magic is what selects the branch).
A JAR, e.g. STRRAT or Adwind.
A .ps1 loader given as the input itself. Optional: the same tool already runs on PowerShell decoded from behaviour.
